frozen_before_B.criterion: B to R no worse than A to R within the A-prime-to-R versus A-to-R noise floor; old A/B/A-prime gate retained as reference
frozen_before_B.g2: GSM64, 13 structured C1/C3, 8 short before/after; each count difference against P and A at most 1
frozen_before_B.conditioning: All arms and R teacher-force the same 256-token A reference continuation per frozen input; independently generated divergent contexts are excluded from distribution comparisons.

loss_metrics.top1: fraction of teacher-forced positions whose argmax differs from R
loss_metrics.KL_mean: mean over positions of KL(R || arm), using complete normalized vocabulary distributions
loss_metrics.max_target_logprob_difference: maximum absolute logprob difference from R for tokens in the fixed A reference continuation
loss_metrics.first_divergence_per_case: 256 - first zero-based teacher-forced argmax disagreement index with R; 0 if no disagreement among 256 positions

frozen_before_B.inequality: For every loss metric (and every case for first divergence), L(B,R) <= L(A,R) + abs(L(A_prime,R)-L(A,R)); multiplier 1.0, no absolute floor. B0 is reported separately and is not the adoption candidate.
frozen_before_B.censoring: Target absent from top-k: record a bound, never substitute an exact value. Shared-top-k conditional KL remains auxiliary and cannot certify full KL. Missing/overlapping bounds or unavailable full KL leave the R gate indeterminate unless a bound proves failure. No adoption with an indeterminate metric.
frozen_before_B.old_G1: B versus A loss <= same-round A_prime versus A loss, multiplier 1.0; censored-noise threshold remains a lower bound, never an exact threshold.
frozen_before_B.collection_status: Only the protocol is frozen; no numeric same-round thresholds or R distributions have been collected.

cpu_subset_protocol.position_semantics: Zero-based positions in A reference continuation, not prompt tokens. Preserve full original prompt and the identical A continuation prefix; truncating the prompt is a different experiment and not permitted here.
cpu_subset_protocol.A_reference_continuation: Fresh same-round A greedy continuation, frozen with SHA before reading R or B/B0. Existing wy-2 continuation is only for historical >=13 analysis, never substituted for the fresh continuation.
cpu_subset_protocol.reference: Same Qwen3.6-35B-A3B original BF16 or higher precision weights, pure torch eager CPU, no quantized or Ascend operators, no new downloads. A different model or partial weight fixture cannot serve as model-level R.
cpu_subset_protocol.required_target: Fixed A continuation token at each selected position. Record explicit target logprob if available, otherwise an upper bound at smallest returned top-k logprob. Do not silently increase k after observing B.
cpu_subset_protocol.top1_metric: Fraction of selected positions where arm argmax differs from R.
cpu_subset_protocol.KL_metric: Auxiliary conditional KL(R || arm), normalized on the same explicit support: intersection of R,A,A_prime,B,B0 returned top-20 keys per position. Report support size and covered probability mass for every arm. Empty support makes KL unavailable. This is not full-vocabulary KL. Aggregate mean and maximum; retain pairwise comparator output separately.
cpu_subset_protocol.target_difference_metric: Maximum absolute target logprob difference versus R; use intervals when either side is censored. Two censored targets do not define an exact difference.
cpu_subset_protocol.first_divergence_metric: Per-case divergent suffix fraction within selected prefix: (N-first_argmax_disagreement_index)/N; 0 for no disagreement. Report index as well.
cpu_subset_protocol.adoption: For every scalar loss metric and each case first-divergence loss: L(B,R)-L(A,R) <= abs(L(A_prime,R)-L(A,R)), multiplier=1, absolute_floor=0. Interval arithmetic must prove the inequality for a pass or its negation for a fail; otherwise indeterminate. An unavailable metric cannot pass. B0 is diagnostic only.
cpu_subset_protocol.parallel_records: On exactly this subset also record A_prime versus A noise and B versus A deviation, with censor locations and bounds. Fresh same-round A and A_prime are mandatory; old wy-4 noise is historical only.
cpu_subset_protocol.cpu_resource_rule: Hold /tmp/a310-cpu-heavy.lock for weight conversion/loading/inference and heavy parsing. Check original weight completeness before loading, inspect cgroup/available RAM, use bounded layer/chunk execution if feasible, never allocate the whole 35B model speculatively. No CUDA allocation.
cpu_subset_protocol.execution_state: Selection and protocol frozen before R/B; no R or new B data read.
